SFR1 sir is one of the best faculty . He really makes the study easy for the student. For learning , he is the best choice. He will explain the topics and always ready for qustions. Don't hesitate to ask questions. He will try his best to answer your question and explain the problem again and again if he has to .

You should feel lucky that you got the chance to do CSE215 under SFR1. He is a highly knowledgeable and skilled faculty. By the way, he won't show the very basics of Java. But, if you have a good grasp of the topics taught in CSE115, you are good to go. His teaching is mostly based on theory. On very rare occasions, he will code in front of the students (sometimes, he might not at all). But trust me, if you are good at the basics, those theories will help a lot. His questions are standard (some people might find it extremely difficult). He mostly gives theory questions, but he also puts some programming problems. You have to be super prepared and efficient to ace the exams. Just a note-he looks at your class position while grading. So, don't panic if your marks in the exams appear low since the only thing that matters is your class position. Also, another piece of advice, try to think of project ideas from the very first.
